newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.322 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.322 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.322 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.331 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on October 10, raised 913.85 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.667 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on October 3, raised 925.40 million and was priced at 99.661 percent.
